await (async(page)=>{const q=page.qa;q.mark='prep-first';q.prepStart=new Date().toISOString();await page.evaluate(()=>{window.qaGate=[];const read=()=>{const items=[...document.querySelectorAll('nav[aria-label="파이프라인 단계"] a')].slice(6).map(e=>({text:e.textContent,href:e.getAttribute('href'),disabled:e.getAttribute('aria-disabled')}));const entry={time:new Date().toISOString(),items};if(JSON.stringify(window.qaGate.at(-1)?.items)!==JSON.stringify(items))window.qaGate.push(entry);};window.qaObserver=new MutationObserver(read);window.qaObserver.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,attributes:true,childList:true});read();});q.beforeNav=await q.nav();const running=page.waitForResponse(async r=>r.url().includes('/prep/')&&r.url().includes('/status')&&(await r.json().catch(()=>({}))).status==='running',{timeout:25000});await page.getByRole('button',{name:'전처리 실행',exact:true}).click();const rr=await running;q.running={time:new Date().toISOString(),status:await rr.json(),nav:await q.nav()};await page.screenshot({path:q.dir+'/QA-EDGE-002-running.png'});return {before:q.beforeNav,running:q.running,body:await page.getByRole('main').innerText()};})(page);
